items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: his name is Georg, and he started studying piano when he was six or seven. As usual, I’d have to say, “Go down and practice your lesson now.”

ctx.x: And doing just what Addison wanted to do, go get that formal education.

Yeah, it’s funny because his name is Georg, and he started studying piano when he was six or seven. As usual, I’d have to say, “Go down and practice your lesson now.” He would go down, but you had to tell him. Then one day, he got it into his head that he wanted to play the bass, and you didn’t have to tell him to go down and practice the bass, which is the way it should be.
Was he interested in playing jazz early on?
